name: Why does storm-related finish damage occur frequently in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Why does storm-related finish damage occur frequently in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the greater Denver area, intense spring and summer hailstorms combined with heavy wind-driven rain frequently breach roof flashings, siding, and window seals. Colorado's rapid temperature swings and dry climate can cause exterior building materials to expand and contract, creating micro-gaps where sudden downpours penetrate. Once moisture enters Denver-area homes, dry interior air can cause rapid surface drying while moisture remains trapped behind the drywall, making thorough moisture checks essential before any interior painting or finish carpentry takes place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver's severe hailstorms and wind-driven rain drive water past roof flashings and window seals, trapping moisture behind drywall before surface drying occurs.
